name: Heavy Cream
siboNotes: Heavy cream is naturally very low in lactose due to high fat content, making it well-tolerated in SIBO. The fat content may slow gastric emptying, which can be beneficial for some SIBO patients.
preparationTips: Use room temperature cream for better whipping results
Can be frozen in ice cube trays for convenient portioning
Avoid ultra-pasteurized versions if making cultured dairy products
Store opened cream for maximum 7-10 days refrigerated
alternatives: Silken tofu blended with plant milk
nutritionalHighlights: High in fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E, K
Rich source of saturated and monounsaturated fats
Very low in lactose compared to other dairy products
